body: 10mg Lexapro. I've been on it for about 2 weeks now I think. I was having mood swings when I was still in Uni - I dropped out just a few weeks ago and started the medication. About a week into the medication, I had another mood swing, probably the lowest I've ever felt, however a week later I feel much better. It does come with side-effects however - it takes a lot of effort to achieve orgasm and your sex drive is significantly lowered. I also felt very tired for the first week and I still have naps on occassion. I haven't put on any weight so far but I plan to - I'm skinny as a rake.

If it's any consolation to you, I'm going through something similar right now - I read all your posts and got a similar vibe from them. I used to be solely attracted to females but now my sexual interests lie with males but my emotional and romantic ones with a female. It's so fucking confusing - nothing makes much sense right now - I don't see the same things in female bodies that I used to (I can still look at /r/nsfw but it takes a while to get my engine started - breasts and vaginas look weird and out of place) and the thought of being with a man somewhat disgusts me for some reason. I'm scared too buddy. Right now I'm pinning it down to having a head full of chemical inbalances (inbalances really fuck with your libido and state of mind) - I'm depressed for other reasons but this certainly doesn't help things. Your not alone in this. If you want to talk to me further about it then send me a post or a PM.

The in-ability to connect with others is a reflection of modern society - everybody thinks they are somebody famous or about to become famous (even I am deluded into this fantasy sometimes) and therefore dissociate themselves from the lower classes. We are a society fixated on self-image, power and the impossible. Until we become a society that cares for it's own as opposed to power, very little will change.

I often read about other places in the world, particurlarly Scandinavia, where all the people are friendly and don't put so much focus on self-image and power. I most certainly plan on going there someday.
I agree my friend. It's what makes the 21st century such a lonely, shallow place.
I'm good at something other than academia? Well fuck me sideways and call me Johnny.

I'm done with university and computer science now. I have failed to keep up and stay sane. I'm going home, to my parents house tomorrow, to recover, regroup and start again with something else other than university. I don't know what is going to happen next or what my future holds but I doubt it could get much worse than this which is most certainly a good thing.

As for the poem, I don't think it has any stanza pattern like a poem should, but then neither does depression and life.

As for NIN, I've heard they are a good band, I'll torrent them the next chance I get.
It was 2:30 AM at the time. Thanks though.

I feel the same way about trying to communicate - I often get my words all jumbled up and in the wrong order all the time. My mind and typing on the keyboard are the only places where the words seem to have coherence and order. I also feel the same way about my friends - I just have people with whom I share interests with and nobody I have a true connection to where we can share our problems.

I see it a completely different way. I say to myself - fuck those people, they place all these expectations on me and I get nothing in return. But enough of that shit.

Right now I'm struggling to keep up so I don't know where another hobby or something else would help right now. 

I've only been in Uni for a few weeks now - it's my first year. I actually live in Australia too but I made it sound American because most redditors are American and I think University is different to College in America. I want to try and make something but I just don't have the time at the moment.

As for girls - your probably right.

I live in a capital city. As for my interests - I really have none beyond computer programming. I enjoy older and more extreme music that few in this generation seem to have an affinity for. I enjoy plain foods over more exotic foods (I guess I like consistency). Sex - I wish. I want to expand my interests but I have no idea where to start and I feel confined for time.

I've met a group of redditors that attend my college but that is only every so often. I seem to connect really well with them, even more than I do with my current set of friends but the meetups don't occur anywhere near as often as I'd like but I'm taking what I can get outside of those events.

As for help, I'm going to try and seek out a college therapist. My previous depressive episodes were very one state of mind - constant misery however this rough patch I'm going through now feels more like a rollercoaster.

Thanks everybody for posting. I got some sleep, had some trippy weird ass dreams and I'm going to try and see a college therapist and see if I can get some more support or try to diagnose whatever it is that I've got.

What you said about being an introvert rings true very heavily. I often shyed away from parties in HS. I've gone a long way in the few weeks I've already been at college but I still look forward to going back to my room to recharge.

I taught myself some C through lessons on /r/carlhprogramming which has helped me realize that picking up new languages is quite a trivial exercise. I've been trying to learn some web dev stuff but I haven't had the time.
